# Handoff contract v1 golden fixtures

Copied unchanged from `0bnoxide/AutoGIS-Civil3D` at commit `4ce15eb` (`fixtures/v1`), where they
are generated deterministically by `tools/AutoGIS.Civil3D.FixtureBuilder`. All identifiers,
metadata, coordinates and TIN geometry are synthetic. Do not edit the ZIP bytes; regenerate them
in the source repository and copy them again.

`valid/unknown-vertical-datum.zip` is valid with warning `WRN001`. Every other expected status and
primary issue code is listed in `../golden.rs`.
